extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF results, Fig. 1 caption/text, and Table 3; mechanism claims are intentionally bounded to phenotypic and inferred evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill assays support a phenotypic bactericidal effect for LfcinB (20–25)4 against Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923 at MIC, 2 MIC, and 4 MIC exposure; this is not a molecular target assignment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure and text provide phenotypic killing over time, not membrane-permeabilization measurements or intracellular target evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Checkerboard assays support synergistic or indifferent peptide-antibiotic effects listed in Table 3; synergy is a combination-effect phenotype, not a resolved molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LfcinB-derived peptides with ciprofloxacin or vancomycin
mechanism_claims.limitations: FIC values support combination effect calls only; they do not identify a direct membrane target or intracellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The discussion proposes membrane-surface interaction/permeability as a possible explanation for synergy and LfcinB-derived peptide activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is author interpretation grounded in prior literature and observed phenotypes; no direct membrane permeabilization assay is locally present for this paper.
